ache.title: Look who spotted the trap from the inside
ache.note: Back in 2024, Nero was already calling out how Pokémon Unite’s timed events push you to spend on skins, and asking if that model fits a family-friendly Nintendo game. He was still in the loop, but he saw it. ...I’m a little proud of him. Don’t tell him. And yes: the matches are fun without buying skins.
ache.tip: Put a skin on a wishlist instead of in your cart. If you’ve forgotten it by the event’s end, it wasn’t love.

videoData.title: How to Keep Playing and Avoiding Gacha Addiction | Pokémon Unite

textData.text: In this episode, I discuss the legislative challenges Pokémon Unite faces in Europe, and why its business model isn't suitable for a family-friendly platform like Nintendo. I share tips on avoiding spending too much on in-game skins and highlight how timed events create pressure to spend. Using personal examples, I explain the psychological tricks of gacha elements and why it's important to avoid overspending. I emphasize playing the game for fun without needing to buy skins, while discussing the costs and benefits of the game's currency and subscription models. Join me as I focus on enjoying Pokémon Unite in a healthy, wallet-friendly way!
